statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains at the lower WATCH boundary as Nasdaq-100 futures are softer alongside 5%+ Treasury yields and oil above $107, while current public evidence does not verify a persistent one-way NQ path.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Cross-asset Stress remains extreme; a higher Tail state would require observed directional efficiency, shallow pullbacks, repeated failed retracements, session-extreme holding or another current amplifier.
headline: Tail remains at WATCH as 5% yields and elevated oil pressure Nasdaq futures
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq-100 e-minis down 0.58% at 08:55 UTC, the U.S. 10-year near 5.03%, and Brent at $107.35 at 10:02 UTC. Broader equities were described as resilient rather than panicked. The backdrop supports extreme Stress, but persistent no-retracement NQ structure is not verified.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock hours, Tail declined from elevated event/whipsaw readings on Monday into low overnight, then returned to WATCH as the yield, oil and technology backdrop strengthened. The latest published 10:00 UTC assessment was 20% Tail with 96% Stress.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 20% WATCH because rates, oil and softer Nasdaq futures are aligned, while persistent one-way NQ structure remains unverified. Conditional Tail peaks at 24% during the 13:00 UTC hour containing the U.S. cash open, then falls if meaningful retracement and two-way price discovery remain available.

forecast.analysis: Reuters' 08:55 UTC update had Nasdaq-100 e-minis 0.58% lower, with the U.S. 10-year near 5.03%; Brent was $107.35 at 10:02 UTC. Cross-asset pressure is aligned, but persistent no-retracement NQ structure is not verified.
